title: The Diagnostic and Predictive Significance of Immune-Related Genes and Immune Characteristics in the Occurrence and Progression of IgA Nephropathy.
summary: ML-selected immune-related genes plus expression and immune-cell analyses identified IgA-nephropathy diagnostic signatures and a macrophage/CD4-cell imbalance.
ai_technology: ML built a six-gene diagnostic model; temporal expression, ceRNA, and ssGSEA analyses connected the selected genes to lesion progression and glomerular immune composition.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: ML-selected immune-related genes plus expression and immune-cell analyses identified IgA-nephropathy diagnostic signatures and a macrophage/CD4-cell imbalance.
evidence.unknown: The gene/signature and immune-cell findings are computational associations in the studied cohorts; they do not establish causality or therapeutic efficacy.
evidence.ai_role: ML built a six-gene diagnostic model; temporal expression, ceRNA, and ssGSEA analyses connected the selected genes to lesion progression and glomerular immune composition.
